summary: Iter 228s backend verification — Roster Draft Picks chronological sort + 55+4+2 count scenario. ALL 37 iter228k-s tests pass (100%). The de-dup-key fix (drafts.py L1314-1325) correctly allows multiple drafts in the same calendar year to each seed independent pick rows. The TFHL acceptance scenario (Inaugural 55 + Summer Entry 4 + Winter 2 = 61 picks per team in 2026) is verified by test_team_draft_picks_count_matches_rounds_times_team_count. Chronological sort by `draft_scheduled_time` is surfaced on every pick via GET /api/teams/{id}/draft-picks (drafts.py L391-475).
critical_code_review_comments: drafts.py L1314-1325 fix is correct: `(league_id, draft_id, year, round, original_team_id)` dedup key now scopes idempotency per-draft instead of per-year, which is the right semantic for leagues with multiple drafts per calendar year.

drafts.py L391-475 (get_team_draft_picks): `draft_scheduled_time` is correctly surfaced for both explicit `draft_id`-tagged picks AND legacy fallback path that joins by (league_id, year). Both branches set the field consistently (None when unmappable).

Note: drafts.py is 3211 lines — exceeds the >700-line code-review threshold. Recommend splitting into draft_routes/draft_seed/draft_pick_owner modules in a future cleanup pass. Not blocking for this iteration.
Out of scope (frontend code review skipped per testing_type='backend only'): TeamDraftPicks.tsx and the new EditDraftDialog.tsx extraction were not reviewed in this run.
test_credentials: Did not need provided admin/commissioner creds — tests register fresh users per scenario via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest creates its own ephemeral league + drafts (UUID-suffixed names) using the authenticated test user. No shared seed data; no teardown required as data is namespaced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 228s backend is fully green. The de-dup-key fix is verified by the explicit 55+4+2 TFHL scenario test. If frontend testing is requested next, exercise the Roster page on a league with at least 2 drafts in the same year — verify (a) per-pick '+ Add' button has data-testid=roster-pick-add-{year}-{round}-{idx} and is always visible, (b) section ordering follows draft_scheduled_time ASC, (c) per-section count badge matches actual pick count, (d) EditDraftDialog renders without @ts-nocheck regressions.
rca of the issue: Root cause was in _seed_draft_picks_for_draft: the idempotency guard queried draft_picks by (league_id, year, round, original_team_id) WITHOUT draft_id. When a league scheduled multiple drafts in the same calendar year, the 2nd/3rd drafts' seed loop found rows inserted by the 1st draft and skipped every insert — so only one draft's picks ever materialised. Reproduction: create a league with 3 drafts all in 2026 (rounds 55/4/2); pre-fix, only 55 picks per team appeared; post-fix, all 61 picks per team appear and are correctly attributed to their parent draft via draft_id. Mitigation: include draft_id in the dedup key. Verified via test_team_draft_picks_count_matches_rounds_times_team_count (asserts 55/4/2 per draft_name) and test_team_draft_picks_include_draft_scheduled_time (asserts each pick carries parent draft's scheduled_time).
